added.title: Payer Back Office Strategy / Technology / Operations Consultant, Senior Manager
added.description:
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance.

As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.

Growing as a strategic advisor, you leverage your influence, expertise, and network to deliver quality results. You motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. As you increase in autonomy, you apply sound judgment, recognising when to take action and when to escalate. You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.

Skills

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.

Apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and/or opportunities.

Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.

Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.

Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.

Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.

Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.

Model and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.

The Opportunity

As part of the Operations Consulting team you will lead the development of AI-enabled operating models and transformation roadmaps across core payer functions. As a Senior Manager, you will serve as a strategic advisor, leveraging your knowledge to drive operational transformation and deliver measurable outcomes for clients. This role offers the chance to engage with senior stakeholders, shape innovative solutions, and contribute to a high performing team culture that values inclusivity and excellence.

Responsibilities

Lead the creation of AI-driven operating models and transformation strategies
Engage with senior stakeholders to develop innovative solutions
Drive measurable outcomes through impactful project management
Utilize analytical skills to identify and address client needs
Promote continuous improvement initiatives in operational practices

What You Must Have

Bachelor's Degree
At least 7 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Master's Degree in Business Administration preferred
Proven success leading workstreams in consulting or payer settings
Understanding payer operations, payer value chain, and technology platforms
Driving automation and advanced analytics solutions
Structuring complex analyzes and synthesizing insights
Coaching and mentoring junior staff for team culture
Working with senior stakeholders for actionable plans
Facilitating workshops and communicating recommendations
Experience with technology platforms, automation tools, analytics solutions, or AI/ML capabilities supporting payer operations

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

added.title: Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The company is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. The focus is on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, the organization develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. The work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

The organization is at a pivotal stage of growth as it approaches completion of the first year of its strategic plan. Over the next five years, the intention is to significantly expand reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

The company is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own the end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.

Key Responsibilities

Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance
Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization’s core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.

Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture
Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.

Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance
Lead organization-wide information security initiatives across all corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit comprehensive enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries) across internal architectures in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Platform Boundaries
Partner closely with other leadership to turn high-level concepts and early-stage prototypes into operational reality. Evaluate alpha projects and PoCs built across departments and lead the execution to either seamlessly integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, highly scalable services.
Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.

Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight
Serve as the direct manager for the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), setting shared goals and ensuring alignment between product/engineering/data strategy and enterprise technology, infrastructure, and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.

Team Leadership & Operational Culture
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing, service-oriented IT and security team tailored to the organization's mission and growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for employees.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including as a Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or CTO.
Demonstrated experience running enterprise IT and IS stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, encompassing SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executives, and Board members.
Proven track record of building and leading technical staff across a wide range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through a period of organizational growth.

Additional Information

This description reflects the organization’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. The organization retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. The organization has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

Annual salary range: $220,000-$230,000
, commensurate with experience
Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by the organization.
2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
2 weeks of US office closure
10 days of paid sick leave annually.
403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
8 weeks of paid parental leave

The organization offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because it operates in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

The hiring company is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

added.description:
About the Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. The organization is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. It is a three-time recipient of a prestigious industry award, backed by top investors.

Our Team

The team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. They embody core leadership principles in their work and culture. The organization is a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

This individual takes ownership beyond their remit and does not wait for a clean, fully-scoped mandate before moving. They lead through strong managers, but do not hide behind them: when something needs fixing, they are just as likely to jump in and fix it themselves as they are to coach someone else through it. They think critically and move fast, comfortable making calls with incomplete information and adjusting as they learn more.

This person will thrive in this role if they get energy from operating across multiple different functions, some they know deeply, some they are learning as they go, and they are honest with themselves and others about which is which. They will thrive here if they see an evolving scope as an opportunity rather than a liability.

What You'll Do

Own the tech stack and teams that run operations at the organization.
Lead established technical systems architecture and admin teams, redesigning the go-to-market stack for efficiency in an AI-first world.
Personally own and drive select high-priority workstreams and initiatives directly, not solely through delegation.
Deliver impactful, company-wide capabilities that improve business outcomes and drive key decisions, while supporting the business’s operating cadence.
Manage a team of managers and individual contributors across functions, stepping in directly wherever the situation requires it.
Drive AI-native transformation across every function owned, including hands-on build where appropriate.

What You've Done

Led a multi-function technical or operational organization, managing managers across domains.
Owned outcomes, not just outputs. Achieved business impact like growth, efficiency, conversion, retention, not just dashboards or insights. This role will help shape the future of the company.
Worked closely enough with data engineering, software engineering, or technical systems to troubleshoot issues directly, not just interpret reports from others.
Operated in a mid-size, high-growth company where building was required without inheriting mature infrastructure.
Navigated a role or organization structure that changed shape over time, and adapted their own scope and approach accordingly.
Built AI-native workflows or tooling that materially changed how a team or company operated, not incremental automation, but real step-function change in how work got done.
Collaborated closely with C-suite and executive leaders to shape strategy using data, including creating structure in ambiguity.

This role is not a fit if...

You prefer a role with a fully-defined, static scope; this organization and mandate are still being shaped, and will continue to shift based on where strengths land.
You lead primarily through delegation and expect managers to fully own execution; this role requires you to personally step in and drive work directly, not just direct others.
You rely on authority to get things done; success in this role requires influencing across teams with competing priorities, not just managing within your organization.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering
who enjoys building as much as leading. You'll help shape how engineering works. We're entering an exciting phase of growth that requires evolving our engineering organization. You'll build scalable processes, technical governance, engineering metrics, and development practices that support increasingly sophisticated products while preserving the speed, creativity, and entrepreneurial culture that have made Fieldpiece successful. You’ll help decide when to build capability, when to build process, and when to leverage external expertise - all while ensuring Fieldpiece retains ownership of the product architecture, customer experience, and technologies that differentiate us in the market.

This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028.
Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years , we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers.

What You'll Do

Build scalable engineering processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable the organization to grow while maintaining speed, quality, and innovation.
Establish a scalable platform architecture that promotes reuse across hardware, firmware, software, and connected technologies while improving product quality, accelerating development, and supporting long-term maintainability.
Help evolve the organization from entrepreneurial product development to a more scalable engineering operation while preserving the agility and customer focus that define Fieldpiece.
Establish consistent product development practices, technical reviews, design standards, metrics, and decision-making frameworks across engineering disciplines.

What Success Looks Like

Become a trusted leader within the engineering organization while building strong cross-functional partnerships across Product Management, Operations, Quality, and external engineering partners that enable the organization to operate as one integrated product development team.
Establish an engineering operating model that balances technical excellence, scalable processes, and organizational agility - knowing when to build internal capabilities, when to standardize processes, and when to leverage external expertise to accelerate innovation.
Strengthen engineering execution by implementing scalable development processes, technical governance, meaningful performance metrics, and resource planning that ensure the right mix of internal talent and external partners to deliver best-in-class products.
Develop and execute a roadmap for the engineering capabilities, technologies, and organizational investments needed to support Fieldpiece's continued growth in connected products, AI-enabled solutions, and platform-based engineering.

Qualifications

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or another STEM discipline
12+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within FLC R&D / new product development environments.
Demonstrated success building, developing, and mentoring high-performing matrixed engineering teams through process improvement, performance management, and organizational planning.
Strong strategic leadership skills with the ability to balance long-term organizational development with short-term business priorities.
Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, especially when navigating complex technical and organizational challenges.
Experience partnering with ODMs, global suppliers, or international engineering organizations.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, resource planning, and investment prioritization.
Experience implementing Lean product development or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at every level of the organization.

Bonus Points If You Have

Master's degree or MBA is a plus.
Experience leading engineering organizations that develop connected products, embedded systems, or IoT technologies.

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece

As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short-term results.
Work alongside talented, collaborative teammates who are passionate about innovation and solving real world problems.
Make a meaningful impact in a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business.

Benefits & Perks

We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well-being, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting
Generous paid time off and paid holidays
Hire to Retire philosophy - Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices)
Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes

Our Culture

At Fieldpiece, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers every day. We believe in:

Teamwork – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team.
Urgency – We move quickly, stay agile, and focus on what matters most.
Respect – We value diverse perspectives and treat everyone with professionalism and integrity.
Trust – We build strong relationships through accountability and transparency.
Learning – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, and personal growth.
No Ego – We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect.

At Fieldpiece, we're building more than innovative products - we're building careers. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we'd love to meet you.

added.title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The company is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. It addresses a significant economic inefficiency: millions of highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing substantial forgone wages and untapped productivity for the economy. The organization's model has proven effective, with jobseekers entering programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and being placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, the organization has supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy. The organization is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. It is committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. The organization operates nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes an American advantage.

This role is responsible for building and leading the organization's technology strategy and infrastructure to support both internal operations and externally facing digital products. This includes staff-facing technology as well as the technical infrastructure that enables jobseeker and partner experiences. This leader partners closely with the CEO, President, and executive leadership to ensure technology is a strategic enabler of the organization's mission, helping the organization transition towards an AI and product-first model while maintaining strong operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. The organization will integrate AI into all aspects to drive operational excellence, improve jobseeker opportunities and outcomes, and this role will help lead these efforts. The VP of Technology is expected to be both strategic and execution-oriented: setting direction, making tradeoffs clear, and delivering consistently across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & AI Infrastructure
Own the organization's technology strategy across staff infrastructure and jobseeker/partner-facing products, ensuring both are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned to mission outcomes.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering staff infrastructure and IT operations, data systems and reporting, Salesforce/platform evolution, core digital products (jobseeker portal, online learning, partner tools), and integrations/interoperability across systems.
Translate organizational strategy into a sequenced plan with clear timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures.
Provide clear tradeoffs and recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team on what to prioritize, defer, or stop based on capacity and impact.
Support sprint planning, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.

Product & Engineering Partnership (Jobseeker + Partner Products)
Partner deeply with Product leadership to deliver a reliable, scalable technology foundation for the organization's jobseeker and partner ecosystem.
Ensure strong cross-functional delivery across product/tech/programs, including planning, prioritization, technical feasibility, timelines, and adoption/change management.
Partnering with the Product Director, guide the technical approach to product delivery (architecture, build vs. buy, integration strategy, platform choices) and ensure consistent execution quality.

AI Enablement and Responsible Technology Innovation
Partner with the Executive team, Product, and Program leadership to identify and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve jobseeker outcomes and staff productivity.
With a cross-department steering committee, establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI use, including data privacy and consent, security controls and vendor risk assessment, quality assurance and bias considerations, and human oversight/escalation paths.
Build the technical foundation required for AI-readiness: data quality, integration, and scalable infrastructure to support AI features and experimentation.

IT Operations, Service Delivery and Training (Staff & Product Infrastructure)
Lead internal IT operations to ensure strong service delivery across the organization (helpdesk, devices, access control, onboarding/offboarding, troubleshooting).
Establish service standards (response times, escalation, documentation, internal communications) and continuously improve the staff technology experience.
Own vendor relationships and contracts across key systems and managed service providers.
Ensure all staff are trained to use the infrastructure and tools, including AI, to maximum effect. Delivery includes accountability to staff usage, ensuring technology is utilized with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.

Systems, Data, and Platform Leadership (Salesforce + Reporting)
Oversee Salesforce and related systems as the operational backbone for Programs, Development, and organizational reporting.
Strengthen system usability, adoption, and reliability through clear requirements gathering, prioritization, and iterative improvements.
Own data strategy in partnership with research and evaluation leadership: governance, quality, reporting, and dashboard reliability.
Ensure the organization has trusted reporting that supports program improvement, fundraising narratives, and leadership decision-making.

Project Delivery, Execution Discipline & Cross-Functional Leadership
Implement and enforce a consistent project management framework across all technology work.
Lead cross-functional execution so teams experience IT and technology as reliable, transparent, and partnership-driven.
Build a culture of accountability and follow-through within the technology function and across stakeholders.

Security, Risk, and Compliance
Own cybersecurity strategy and operational risk management.
Ensure appropriate controls for systems that handle sensitive data.
Maintain risk register and communicate risks and mitigations clearly to the Executive Leadership Team and the Board as needed.
Ensure technology practices align with funder requirements, privacy expectations, and organizational policies.

Executive Partnership & Communication
Serve as a proactive, consultative partner to the CEO, President, and Executive Leadership Team, bringing clear updates, risks, and decision-ready recommendations.
Communicate in a structured way leadership can act on: what is on track, what is at risk, what decisions are needed, and what tradeoffs are recommended.
Drive follow-through on Executive Leadership Team decisions by documenting commitments, assigning owners, and reporting progress.

Success Measures
A clear, sequenced technology roadmap that covers staff infrastructure and digital products, aligned to strategic priorities.
Strong Product-Tech partnership resulting in reliable delivery of jobseeker and partner-facing features and improvements.
AI capabilities delivered responsibly with governance, safety standards, and measurable impact.
Predictable project delivery with improved cross-functional satisfaction and fewer surprises.
Improved reliability, security posture, and risk management across systems and products.
Executive-level communication that is decision-oriented, clear, and consistent.

Qualifications

10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing products/platforms with demonstrated experience in AI.
Strong program/project delivery discipline; proven ability to manage multiple priorities with constrained resources.
Experience with AI, data governance, enterprise systems, and CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred).
Deep comfort partnering with Product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and delivery.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear decisions.
Commitment to the organization's mission.

Salary Range

$200,000 - $225,000
annually

Salary Disclaimer

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the organization's total compensation package for employees. Benefits include paid time off policy, hybrid or remote work schedule, medical/dental/vision insurance, paid parental leave, short term disability insurance, life insurance, and retirement plan with employer match.

The hiring organization is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
